meta.note: Classic World remaps Victoria Island (map IDs 0100xxxxx) and changes many quests, so pre-Big-Bang guides are only a baseline. meowdb (rebranding to NiaDB) data partly comes from the 2nd closed test and is being re-read from the launch build. All text paraphrased.

secrets.name: The Forest of Patience (jump quest, 5 steps)
secrets.howToGet: Talk to Shane in Ellinia; he charges an entry fee. Climb 5 obstacle stages to the herb at the top.
secrets.level: 25+ for Sabitrama's quest (anyone can pay to enter)
secrets.reward: Pink Anthurium for Sabitrama's quest (Sleepywood, Lv25): 3,060 EXP, 804 mesos, +1 fame, random Overall Armor DEF scroll (Intermediate or Greater). Completing it unlocks free entry from Shane.

secrets.name: The Deep Forest of Patience (jump quest, 7 steps)
secrets.howToGet: Use the Mysterious Statue NPC in Sleepywood town to warp in; 7 platforming stages. Sabitrama's Lv50 follow-up also routes via Shane in Ellinia and says the herb is deeper in the forest. Its quests need Lv 65 at launch (it was 45 in testing).
secrets.reward: Sabitrama's Anti-Aging Medicine (Lv50): 12,900 EXP, 1,579 mesos, +2 fame, Star Rock, permanent free entry. John's Pink Flower Basket (Lv65, John in Lith Harbor, 10 Pink Violas): 25,900 EXP, 2,032 mesos, +1 fame, 30 Screws; 3-part chain (John's Present, John's Last Present).

secrets.name: Shumi's Lost Coin (Construction Site B1)
secrets.howToGet: Accept from Shumi in Kerning City (after Proof of Companionship). Enter the Kerning City Subway (Subway Ticketing Booth) and work down to Construction Site B1; the normal entrance is blocked, so you have to platform your way in.
secrets.reward: 6,720 EXP, 1,111 mesos, +1 fame, 5 Nearest-Town return scrolls plus 3 each of Lith Harbor/Ellinia/Perion/Henesys/Kerning/Sleepywood return scrolls

secrets.name: Shumi's Lost Roll of Cash (Construction Site B2)
secrets.howToGet: Second step from Shumi; go deeper to Construction Site B2 (watch for moving machinery).
secrets.reward: 6,720 EXP, 1,111 mesos, +2 fame, 30 Blue Potions

secrets.name: Shumi's Lost Sack of Cash (Construction Site B3)
secrets.howToGet: Final step from Shumi; reach Construction Site B3 at the bottom of the subway.
secrets.reward: 6,720 EXP, 10,000 mesos, +3 fame, 30 Mana Elixirs (best payout of the three)

secrets.name: Someone Else's House (Mushmom spawn)
secrets.howToGet: Henesys -> An Empty House -> Pig Park -> Pig Park II -> Someone Else's House (single portal from Pig Park II).
secrets.reward: Mushmom (Lv40, 34,440 HP, 340 EXP); respawn about 1-1.5 h. Mushmom is cited as a source of high-tier glove attack scrolls. No Mystic Door or Teleport Rock here.

secrets.name: The Grave of Mushmom (Zombie Mushmom)
secrets.howToGet: Sleepywood -> Ant Tunnel I-IV -> Ant Tunnel Park -> The Grave of Mushmom.
secrets.reward: Zombie Mushmom (Lv55, 66,640 HP, 668 EXP, Holy-weak, undead), respawn about 1-1.5 h. Reference drops (MSEA, unverified for Classic) include Intermediate attack scrolls. Zombie Mushrooms are good Cleric EXP.

secrets.name: The Cursed Sanctuary (Jr. Balrog)
secrets.howToGet: Sleepywood dungeon -> Sanctuary Entrance I -> II -> III -> IV -> The Cursed Sanctuary. Entrance IV has Cold Eyes, Tauromacis and Taurospears.
secrets.reward: Jr. Balrog (Lv80, 325,400 HP, 2,188 EXP, Holy-weak, poison-immune); single spawn about every 3 h. Top-tier boss for the Lv100 cap.

secrets.name: Someone Else's Grave (Rotten Mushmom)
secrets.howToGet: Hidden Street off Decayed Tunnel I inside Forgotten Hollow (inner portal continues to Bygone Days). Opens with the Nov 18 update.
secrets.reward: Rotten Mushmom (Lv60, 86,400 HP, about 850 EXP), the only place it spawns; respawn 1-1.5 h. Bring a party and potions.

secrets.name: Forgotten Hollow entrance (Tree Tunnel)
secrets.howToGet: Start 'Welcome to the Hollow' with Grendel the Really Old in Ellinia; go to The Forest North of Ellinia -> Forest Up North and take the Tree Tunnel down. Forgotten Entrance III has a portal back. Luma sells a Return Scroll to Forgotten Hollow for 800 mesos (Zelya's quest gives 2). A second entrance opens from deep inside Sleepywood.
secrets.reward: 15 quests in 4 chains, about 84k EXP and 19.5k mesos total; 10 new mobs (Lv39-59); hidden streets to Collision of Ice and Fire and The Valley of Death; Hollow PQ from Lv41 planned for Dec 9.

secrets.name: Utah's Pig Farm (troll map)
secrets.howToGet: Off The Forest East of Henesys; Utah is the NPC.
secrets.reward: Full of Lv200 Super Ribbon Pigs that give 0 EXP. Movement skills, return scrolls, Teleport Rocks and channel change are disabled. Novelty/screenshot spot, not a grind map.

secrets.name: The Pig Beach
secrets.howToGet: From 3-Way Road-Split (Victoria Road), take the hidden portal.
secrets.reward: Pigs and Ribbon Pigs (leather, Pig's Ribbons for crafting); a rare Iron Hog (Lv28) on a 1 h timer needed for Weaponcrafting quest 'A Weaponcrafter in My Own Right!' (Lv25, 30 kills). Good alternative 15-20 grind.

secrets.name: Mushroom Garden
secrets.howToGet: Hidden portal from A Hill West of Henesys (leads on to Forest West of Henesys).
secrets.reward: Very dense low-level spawns (34 spawn points, Shrooms/Red Snails/Orange Mushrooms); several beginner quests (Mai, Olaf) tick here.

secrets.name: Marr's Forest (Mar the Fairy)
secrets.howToGet: Hidden Street connected to Ellinia town, next to the Magic Library/Circulation Desk.
secrets.reward: Mar the Fairy, the pet revival NPC ('Mar the Fairy and the Water of Life' quest). Relevant because Classic pets need Water of Life every 30 days.

secrets.name: Thieves' Hideout (Dark Lord)
secrets.howToGet: Single portal from Kerning City.
secrets.reward: Dark Lord: Thief job advancements plus The Dark Lord's Signature (Lv28) and Citizenship quests (Lv57).

secrets.name: The Murky Swamp and Cabin of the Forsaken
secrets.howToGet: Hidden Street from Niora Hospital (Kerning City); continues to Cabin of the Forsaken.
secrets.reward: Jr. Neckis and Lv31 Ligators, about 110k solo EXP/h (site estimate). Breakable Witch's Herb respawns every 1.5-5 min. The Oct 15 patch fixed a rope here.

secrets.name: The Hermit's Cabin (Slade)
secrets.howToGet: At the end of Monkey Swamp I -> II -> III (Hidden Street chain).
secrets.reward: Slade starts two Lv57 Citizenship quests ('The Weight of Truth', 'What It Takes'), each worth 17,800 EXP and 1,784 mesos. Appears to be Classic-new.

secrets.name: Land of Wild Boar / Over the Wall
secrets.howToGet: Hidden portal from Perion Street Corner; inner portal to Over the Wall.
secrets.reward: Wild Boars and Dark Axe Stumps, plus Jr. Boogies on 5-10 min timers; Jane's Final Challenge (100 Dark Axe Stumps). Good 21-30 alternative to KPQ.

secrets.name: The Breathing Rock (to Golem's Temple)
secrets.howToGet: Henesys Dungeon Entrance -> The Breathing Rock -> The Entrance of Golem's Temple -> Golem's Temple I-IV.
secrets.reward: Mixed Blue Mushrooms, Lupins and Lv56 Stone Golems; quest kills for Chief Stan, Jane and Ronnie. Strong party map (about 500k EXP/h with 6+, site estimate).

secrets.name: Caution Falling Down
secrets.howToGet: Hidden Street off Kerning City Construction Site.
secrets.reward: Octopi and Blue Mushrooms; 7 quests progress here, including Chief Stan's and Jane's Blue Mushroom hunts.

secrets.name: Sleepy Dungeon V (Jr. Boogie spawns)
secrets.howToGet: Sleepywood -> Sleepy Dungeon I -> ... -> V. It links to Forgotten Dungeon Tunnel (locked until launch).
secrets.reward: Curse Eyes, Lupins, Dark Stone Golems, and Jr. Boogies on 5/10 min timers. Mob rate was cut to 0.4x in the Oct 15 patch.

secrets.name: Deep Ant Tunnel I-II / Ant Tunnel Park
secrets.howToGet: Sleepywood -> Ant Tunnel I-IV -> Ant Tunnel Park; Deep Ant Tunnel and Dark Cave branch off, with the Mushmom grave at the end.
secrets.reward: Ant Tunnel I is the standard Lv20-21 stop; Evil Eye and Zombie Mushroom zones lead to Zombie Mushmom.

secrets.name: Kerning City PQ (1st Accompaniment)
secrets.howToGet: Party leader talks to Lakelis by the Kerning sewer entrance; exactly 4 players, channels 3-7, 30 minutes.
secrets.reward: Stage EXP, a Companion's Magic Box per member, a chance at Squishy Shoes (Lv28) from King Slime. 'Proof of Companionship' gives a random Intermediate earring scroll and unlocks Shumi's chain. Classic changes: deaths don't end the run, multiple parties per channel.

secrets.name: 2nd job test maps
secrets.howToGet: Warped in by your job instructor during the Lv30 advancement: Ant Tunnel For Bowman, Magician's Tree Dungeon, Thief's Construction Site, Warrior's Rocky Mountain.
secrets.reward: Collect Dark Marbles for the 2nd job advancement. Thief instructor is at Construction Site North of Kerning City.

secrets.name: Pio's boxes and the Green Relaxer (Maple Island)
secrets.howToGet: Pio in Amherst (Beginners, Lv5): break abandoned wooden boxes around town for 2 Rusty Screws + 2 Old Wooden Boards.
secrets.reward: The Green Relaxer chair, 100 EXP and 150 mesos. Only obtainable on Maple Island; the boat to Lith Harbor (Lv7, 300 mesos) is one-way, so finish all island quests first.

secrets.name: Arwen and the Glass Shoe (repeatable)
secrets.howToGet: Arwen the Fairy in Ellinia; farm Fire Boars near Perion for her Glass Shoe.
secrets.reward: 4,430 EXP and 921 mesos per turn-in, plus a random Fairy Wing or Piece of Ice (crafting or quest material).

secrets.name: Free Market Entrance (11 rooms)
secrets.howToGet: Free Market Entrance portals in the major towns.
secrets.reward: Player shops (Store Permits). Classic's whole economy is separate, and this is the main price-discovery spot.

facts: Four grades per family: Lesser 100%, Intermediate 60%, Greater 10%, Chaos 10%. Bonuses depend on the family.
Weapon attack scrolls: Lesser +1, Intermediate +2, Greater +4, Chaos +5. Staff and wand magic attack: +2 / +4 / +8 / +10.
Stat, accuracy, avoid, speed and jump scrolls: +1 / +2 / +3 / +4. HP/MP scrolls: +10 / +15 / +20 / +25 (Lesser is the most efficient there).
Only Chaos can destroy an item: half of failed Chaos scrolls boom it (45% per attempt).

Expected weapon attack per slot: Lesser 1.0, Intermediate 1.2, Greater 0.4, Chaos 0.5. Intermediate (60%) is the best value, which is why 60% scroll prices jumped about 5x by Oct 12 before cooling off.

Lesser weapon scrolls are sold by NPCs (El Moth sells them for 30,000 mesos). Arcforge crafts Lesser hat, top, bottom, shield, shoes and cape-defense scrolls for a 10,000-meso fee; cape stat and glove scrolls need Arcforge Lv 9-10, so they're locked until the crafting cap rises past 8.
52 families, 208 scrolls. This replaces the old 10/60/100/30/70 dark-scroll system. No white scrolls are documented.
5 AP per level, all manual; no auto-assign or free reset at job advance.
SP from Lv10: 3 per level plus 1 bonus at Lv10 (61 SP by Lv30).
AP Reset Scroll costs 7,000 NX (requires Lv10, resets ALL stats including HP/MP-washed AP, never expires). SP Reset Scroll costs 7,000 NX (resets all non-Beginner skills).
The Hands stat is removed and replaced by critical rate and critical damage.
Dying costs EXP, but you can't de-level and there's no loss in towns.
NiaMeowDB models the loss as (5 + 20/LUK)% of the EXP for your next level: 10% at the base 4 LUK, about 7% at 10 LUK and 6% at 20 LUK. Nexon hasn't published the formula.
Safety Charm (Cash Shop, 800 NX for 1, 2,300 for 3, 8,400 for 12) prevents the EXP loss while carried; consumed on use; revives at full HP/MP; tradeable once; expires after 90 days.
Level cap 100; 1st job at Lv10, 2nd job at Lv30 (10 branches). 3rd job, Orbis and El Nath are not in the launch build (being reworked for later).
EXP curve matches pre-Big-Bang through Lv89; from Lv90 each level costs 2.1x the last. Lv99 to 100 alone is about 9.5B EXP (around 52% of the total 18.2B).
Closed-test pace was about 3-4 h for Lv10-20 and 8-9 h for Lv20-30, but 40 monsters give less EXP in the launch build. In Founder's Access, dedicated players reached about Lv 40 in 4-5 days.
Party EXP bonus exists (NiaMeowDB's model: up to about +55% with 6), but you only get party EXP if you've attacked, been hit or used a skill on that map in the last 10 seconds.

Six professions: Smithing, Weaponcrafting, Tailoring, Woodcrafting, Leatherworking, Arcforge (290 recipes usable at launch; 348 in the game data, but Lv 9-10 recipes are locked). Unlocks at Lv10; any character can learn all six.

Each has a mentor NPC and crafting station on Victoria Island. Mentors (from the release notes): Silas Irons (Smithing, Perion), Mr. Thunder (Weaponcrafting, Perion), Francois (Tailoring, Ellinia), Vicious (Woodcrafting, Henesys Market), JM From tha Streetz (Leatherworking, Kerning City), Chrishrama (Arcforge, Sleepywood). Only one weekly crafting quest per week across all professions.

Pipeline: ore drops from mobs, Smithing refines it into ingots (Bronze/Iron/Steel/Mithril/Gold), and ingots plus screws or processed wood become gear. Leather and Pig's Ribbon become Processed Leather or Cloth (5 Leather = 1 Processed Leather; 10 Pig's Ribbons = 1 Processed Cloth).
Crafting Catalysts (1H weapon, 2H weapon, armor, scroll) modify final stats.
Profession level is capped by character level (e.g. craft Lv5 needs char Lv25, Lv6 needs Lv30); excess crafting EXP is wasted.

Cheapest leveling: Woodcrafting (Wooden Baseball Bat, Balanche, Wooden Sword/Wand). Profit-positive at NPC prices: Iron Knuckle (Smithing, +1.5k), Iron/Mithril/Adamantium arrows x500 (Woodcrafting), Black Crystal (Arcforge).
Mushmom (Lv40): Someone Else's House (Henesys hidden), about 1-1.5 h.
Zombie Mushmom (Lv55): The Grave of Mushmom (past Ant Tunnel Park), about 1-1.5 h.
Rotten Mushmom (Lv60, Classic-new): Someone Else's Grave in Forgotten Hollow, about 1-1.5 h, from Nov 18.
Jr. Balrog (Lv80): The Cursed Sanctuary (Sleepywood), about 3 h.
Mini-timers: Iron Hog at Pig Beach 1 h; Jr. Boogies 5-10 min; Fairy spawns about 3 min.
The server ticks about every 7.5 s, and normal mobs respawn on that wave. Zakum and Ludibrium PQ are not in Classic yet.
New content: crafting professions, Citizenship quest chains (from Lv12 in Henesys or Kerning, 123 quests), Forgotten Hollow (Lv39-59), Rotten Mushmom, Monkey Swamp / Hermit's Cabin.
New scroll system (Lesser/Intermediate/Greater/Chaos); Hands stat replaced by crit.
KPQ: no Lv30 cap, death doesn't end the run, multiple parties per channel, tougher King Slime (about 16.8k HP).
Holy Arrow is now one big single-target hit and Fire Arrow is single-target with a burn; archers can shoot at point-blank range; party loot rights are configurable; quest requirements changed.
Taxis are 90% off for Beginners. The EXP curve is steeper from Lv90.
4 explorer classes plus Beginner versus 40+ modern classes; no 3rd-6th job, no star force, cubes, symbols or Arcane systems.
Manual AP/SP; slow leveling; mobs take several hits; death costs EXP.
Separate world and economy: no character, item or IGN transfer. Only the NX balance is shared, and a ban in either game applies to both.
Policy: cosmetics and convenience only; no direct EXP boosters or power items.
AP Reset 7,000 NX; SP Reset 7,000 NX; Safety Charm 800 NX; Megaphone 350 NX, Super Megaphone 1,500 NX. From Oct 21 every megaphone needs Lv 15.
Convenience Essentials Pack 9,900 NX (once per account): AP+SP reset, 1 slot coupon, 10 Safety Charms, 10 Super Megaphones (untradeable). The best value buy.
Slot coupon (+5 inventory or storage slots) 5,000 NX. Selective 5-slot Coupons were the most-mesos-spent item in launch week, around 35k mesos.
Pets 3,500 NX, permanent but need Water of Life (2,000 NX) every 30 days.
Store Permits: Regular 1,500 NX (12 slots, 90 days), Pink 3,000 NX (18 slots); a Special Store Permit comes in Monthly Essentials (9,900 NX). Hired Merchants are not in the game yet.
Hair coupons 5,500 (random) or 7,500 NX (choose); face coupons 3,500 or 5,500 NX. Gifting requires Lv12.
Classic World has its own economy separate from modern Maple.
Direct player trades allowed; a meso tax applies to trades (rate not published).
Untradeable items can't go in storage, the FM or trades; some Cash items are 'tradeable once'.
Personal shop closes if a monster hits or kills you; shops are allowed on most hunting maps.
NX-to-meso rate climbed from about 1.9 mesos per NX on Oct 7 to about 15 by Oct 20 (very volatile).
Launch-week FM: about 41% of meso spend went to cash outfits, 32% to weapons/armor, 18% to scrolls, pots and stars. Iron Ore is the most-traded item (about 500 mesos).

Nexon permanently banned 1,379 accounts in the first week and over 3,000 by Oct 14 (hacking, botting and real-money trading), with no exceptions for Founder buyers. Bans apply to your main MapleStory account too.
Founder's Access Oct 6, 2026, 11:00 PDT ($59.99 Orange Mushroom or $79.99 Zakum pack); progress carries over. Founder's items must be claimed by Nov 30 (leave Maple Island first).
Grand Launch Oct 21, 2026 (free), after maintenance from 6:00 to about 11:00 AM PDT. One world, Windia, with 20 channels. Housing goes live (needs citizenship grade 2).
Events: The Journey Begins from Oct 21, Mark of the Beta into November, Halloween from Oct 28.
Forgotten Hollow and Moon Bunny's Rice Cake (Lv11+) Nov 18. Guilds (made in Lith Harbor), a Forgotten Hollow PQ (Lv41+) and Happyville Dec 9.
3rd job test server planned for early 2027. Ossyria, 3rd job and the Archon raid have no date yet.

moneyMaking.method: Sell crafting ores and materials early
moneyMaking.details: Iron Ore (about 500 mesos), Mithril (about 450), Gold (about 280), Bronze (about 200), Leather (about 250) and Animal Fur Bundles move fastest on the FM because every crafter needs them. Farm Stumps (branches, Bronze Ore), Ribbon Pigs (ribbons, fur), Blue Snails and Slimes (ores and gems).

The 60% scroll price index rose about 5x by Oct 12, then cooled to under 2x by Oct 19 (Claw Attack Intermediate was the 2nd most-viewed item). Green Mushrooms are reported to drop Claw Attack scrolls; Mushmom and Zombie Mushmom drop Intermediate attack scrolls (reference data).

Iron Knuckle (Smithing Lv8, about +1.5k per craft at NPC prices), Iron/Mithril/Adamantium arrows x500 (Woodcrafting, about +0.9-1.2k), Black Crystal (Arcforge Lv6, +800), Hardwood Wand (+710). Figures come from NPC sell-back and closed-test data; check FM prices.
Players sell Cash outfits and Selective 5-slot Coupons (about 35k on Oct 14, 43k+ by Oct 19) on the FM; the rate rose from about 8 mesos per NX on Oct 14 to about 15 on Oct 20.

Track sold prices (not asking prices) for liquid goods: attack scrolls, glove scrolls, throwing stars (Wolbi), Weighted Earrings, Pure Water, Salad. Pure Water fell about 44% in week one, so early dumping beats holding.

Shumi chain (Lv35; B3 alone pays 10k mesos plus 30 Mana Elixirs); Forgotten Hollow quest set (about 19.5k mesos); Arwen's repeatable Glass Shoe (921 mesos plus a material each). Skip Rowen's 570 Cursed Dolls chain for money: it pays 5,700 mesos in total.
A community guide flags Drake hunting grounds (Lv35-55) as having good meso potential; Fire Boars drop Woobie stars and Arwen's shoe.

Trade meso tax rate and any per-day trade limits.
Forest of Patience entry fee amount (meowdb map pages say 'coming soon'); jump-quest item drops at each step.
Pet Walkway (Henesys Pet Park jump quest): no matching map found in the Classic map database, so it is probably absent.
Orbis Tower <Hidden Room> and Ossyria hidden streets (Cave Within the Cave, Holy Ground at the Snowfield, The Crown-Flyer) exist in the data but Orbis and El Nath are NOT in the launch build.
Lith Harbor-specific secrets beyond John's quest and Pig Beach: none found.
Classic drop tables for Mushmom, Zombie Mushmom and Jr. Balrog (meowdb shows MSEA reference or community-sourced data).
Boss respawn timers are from map data plus a few player reports; Nexon controls live timing.
Mysterious Statue in Sleepywood as the Deep Forest of Patience entrance (from quest text; the NPC page has no details).
Collision of Ice and Fire and The Valley of Death (Forgotten Hollow hidden streets): contents unknown until Nov 18.
